method.parser: actual script-free Legado Dart VM operations

limitations: Only eight archived selected sources were sampled; no user settings, database or personal bookshelf was read.
safe_matching_books is a bounded keyword, same-host HTTPS GET and limited text prefilter, not a site safety or content verdict.
An HTTP error, 200 with empty parse, or a single chapter does not prove permanent source failure, security, or full-book readability.
The initial recorded files match the historical Git object after the explicitly recorded CRLF conversion; the collector did not cover every transitive dependency.

The later directly recorded risk-policy file differs from the initial Git object, and its eight direct quarantine dependencies were not included in the captured hashes; the later complete execution environment cannot be reconstructed or bound retroactively.

Temporary collectors and redacted intermediates are not version-controlled, and webpage bodies, work identities, query strings and IP addresses were not retained; historical network and parser output cannot be independently replayed offline.
Offline source-provenance verification requires the referenced historical Git object; shallow clones or source archives without it cannot verify the 38 recorded files or historical ledger.
